title: V5: derive pwmd seal interval from genesis blocks_per_hour
brief: Remove hard-coded 2s seal loop. Compute seal tick from chain GenCfg.blocks_per_hour only (genesis-locked). No --seal-interval-ms CLI.

explicit_non_goals: No CLI/env override for seal interval
No runtime RPC tuning of seal cadence

acceptance_criteria: spawn_seal_loop uses Duration derived from chain cfg blocks_per_hour, not from_secs(2).
blocks_per_hour==0 rejected at genesis load or seal-loop start with clear error.
Startup log line records derived seal_interval_ms and blocks_per_hour.
CY cluster + single-sealer: wall-clock block rate matches 3600000/bph ms within test tolerance.
docs/MVP-checklist.md and docs/runbooks/v5-cy-cluster-precloseout-soak.md updated (expected cadence from genesis).
cargo test -p pwmd --lib lifecycle; cargo check -p pwmd -p pwm-core PASS.
notes: Owner decision: consensus timing must be genesis/code-locked, not operator-tunable.

delegation.invite_note:
Align seal loop with genesis blocks_per_hour.

Remove hard-coded Duration::from_secs(2) in spawn_seal_loop.

Derive: seal_interval_ms = 3_600_000 / blocks_per_hour from chain GenCfg (genesis-loaded).

NO new CLI flag (--seal-interval-ms forbidden).

Read chain cfg at loop start; log derived interval once.

Update MVP-checklist + CY runbook cadence text.

Tests for interval helper.
